name: Reality Glove (StretchSense) worn by N Kim, September 2026 - THE DEFAULT PROFILE
comment: THIS FILE IS THIS OPERATOR'S GLOVE PAIR. REPLACE IT FOR ANOTHER GLOVE OR ANOTHER PERSON: everything below is a measured claim about these two garments on these two hands, not a calibration that transfers. scripts/fuse_poses.py applies profiles/default.json automatically (--profile auto, the default), because these masks were sitting in profiles/ being applied only when somebody remembered the flag - and a report that prints the fusion both ways cannot hide what the mask did. Copy reality_glove_nk_2026-09.json over this file for a different pair, run --profile none to fuse unmasked, or delete this file and the NK profile becomes the fallback. Measured, not guessed. UNRELIABLE right middle/ring/pinky: through sync_day1 and sync_day2 the right glove reports those three partly extended while the camera reads them clearly curled (pinky 1.55-1.68 against the camera's 0.78-0.90, take after take, in thumbs_up and peace) - a fault in that glove's fingers, not evidence about the camera, so they are kept out of the thumb gate's vote. The left glove does not do this and is left alone. RAIL OVERRIDE index only, on both hands: the index is the one finger a slow sweep has shown leaves its rail as soon as the camera sees flexion, so the rail reading is a saturation artefact the camera may overrule. The RIGHT RING is deliberately NOT enabled although it is the next suspect: its 2026-09-20 sweep (dead_zone_right_ring) started with the finger already bent, so the open reference is broken and the sweep has to be repeated with scripts/leap/finger_sweep.py before ring goes in here. Enabling it on an un-repeated sweep would let the camera take a curl on the strength of a measurement we know is spoiled. GLOVE LAG left 0.10 s, right 0.47 s: measured on this laptop's 2026-09-18/20 finger sweeps (cross-correlated curl traces), left about 100 ms, right 455 to 485 ms. A fallback, not an intrinsic glove constant: transport and software latency can change with machine load or XR Trainer version. Used only when the session's own clips cannot measure a lag (a session of held poses never can); a lag the session does measure, or one given with --glove-lag, wins, and --glove-lag none applies nothing.
